name: Jorah guard
description: jorah-guard v0 (P5): marks chats that have read outside text, asks Adam before memory, rules, skill, schedule and coding-job changes from them, limits web addresses to ones already seen, treats voice as needing confirmation, and can freeze Jorah. Fails closed.

matrixFile.description: config/permission-matrix.json; unreadable means every tool is blocked

stateDir.description: Taint state, freeze flag and decision log, mode 700

workspace.description: main's workspace, for classifying file writes

cleanSessionKeys.description: Session keys that can be clean (Adam's own chat)

sitesDir.description: config/sites: one file per signed-in site the site reader may read

sitesPrivateFile.description: Root-owned file with the sites' private parts (a school's address); never in the repo

allowTestSites.description: jorah-dev only: load test sites (plain http to a fake site on loopback)
